info.name: DineHub - Aggressive Negative & Edge Tests
info.description: Aggressive validation, authentication, business-error, boundary, payment and cleanup tests. Tests current behavior without assuming unimplemented services.

exec: pm.test("Unknown user exists check returns 200",()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); pm.test("Result is false",()=>pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql(false));
pm.test("Nonexistent order payment returns 404 or current error",()=>pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([404,500]));
pm.test("Valid status update returns 200",()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); pm.test("Status is success",()=>pm.expect(pm.response.json().paymentStatus).to.eql("success"));
pm.test("Long address is handled without server crash",()=>pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201,400,413]));
